_about: Budgets the daily engineer must stay inside. Change a number only with the owner's OK and a note in docs/TECH-DIRECTION.md.

frame._about: Daily run at 0:40, 390x844 at 3x pixel ratio, Chromium with 4x CPU throttling. js = time inside the game's requestAnimationFrame callback (rules + issuing draw calls). interval = time between frames; it includes canvas rasterising, which headless Chromium does in software, so the High interval budget only catches disasters. v53 measured: High js 0.8/6.9 ms, interval p95 150 ms; Low js 0.4/3.8 ms, interval p95 33 ms.

memory._about: Growth across 5 daily runs, measured after garbage collection.
